title_zh: 【软件正式发布】AI-SCH 仿真器 v1.1.0
body_zh: 【软件正式发布】AI-SCH 仿真器 v1.1.0 正式上线，面向 HarmonyOS NEXT，融合 AI 辅助电路设计、原理图仿真、PCB 2D 布局、3D 板级预览、MCU 调试与虚拟仪器，为高校教学、竞赛训练及工程方案预验证提供一体化电路设计与仿真平台。
body_en: [Official Release] AI-SCH Simulator v1.1.0 is now available on HarmonyOS NEXT — combining AI-assisted circuit design, schematic simulation, PCB 2D layout, 3D board preview, MCU debug, and virtual instruments for education, contests, and engineering pre-validation.
title: 【软件正式发布】AI-SCH 仿真器 v1.1.0
